title: CRISPR screens identify targets to rescue age-related T cell dysfunction in cancer
title_zh: CRISPR筛选鉴定可挽救癌症中年龄相关T细胞功能障碍的靶点
abstract: Immune aging impairs T cell-mediated tumor control as well as cancer immunotherapy outcomes. The most important drivers of T cell dysfunction in aged tumors remain unknown. We performed single-cell CRISPR screens to identify Dusp5 and Zfp219 as key regulators of CD8+ T cell persistence and effector differentiation within aged tumors. Loss of Dusp5 increased extracellular signal-regulated kinase (ERK) phosphorylation and globally enhanced T cell proliferation. Conversely, Zfp219 deletion induced epigenetic reprogramming and increased expression of cytotoxic molecules, enhancing antitumor immunity specifically in aging. Levels of the human ortholog ZNF219 were higher within intratumoral CD8+ T cells from older cancer patients, which correlates with worse survival following immunotherapy. Zfp219 ablation synergized with immune checkpoint inhibitors to expand effector-like CD8+ T cells, leading to tumor clearance in aged mice. Our findings highlight Dusp5 and Zfp219 as critical drivers of age-related T cell dysfunction that can be targeted to rejuvenate antitumor immunity in older cancer patients.
abstract_zh: 免疫衰老削弱T细胞介导的肿瘤控制并降低癌症免疫治疗效果。导致老年肿瘤中T细胞功能障碍的核心驱动因素仍未明确。我们开展了单细胞CRISPR筛选，鉴定出Dusp5与Zfp219是衰老肿瘤内CD8+ T细胞持久性和效应分化的关键调节因子。Dusp5缺失增强ERK（extracellular signal-regulated kinase）磷酸化并普遍提高T细胞增殖。相反，Zfp219缺失诱导表观遗传重编程，提高细胞毒分子表达，特异性增强老龄背景下的抗肿瘤免疫。人类同源基因ZNF219在老年癌患者肿瘤浸润CD8+ T细胞中的水平更高，与免疫治疗后生存更差相关。Zfp219缺失与免疫检查点抑制剂协同，扩增效应样CD8+ T细胞，并在老年小鼠中实现肿瘤清除。我们的发现凸显了Dusp5和Zfp219作为年龄相关T细胞功能障碍的关键驱动因子，可被靶向以重塑老年癌患者的抗肿瘤免疫。
